help.spirit-card.title: {cardType, select, druid{Druid} elder{Elder Spirit} bear{Bear Spirit} fox{Fox Spirit} other{Owl Spirit}} Card
spirit-card.druid.near.desc: When you place a Spirit card to the left or right of your Druid, completed recruitment symbols (<recrutement />) allow you to immediately recruit an Elite card of the corresponding type. The played card is then placed on the Druid and becomes your Transformation, all your cards of this type in the Groves gain +1<force />!
spirit-card.type.bonus.note: (cards of the same type as the Grove receive +1<force />)
spirit-card.force.desc: Determines who wins control of the Grove: at the end of the round, the player with the highest total Strength under this Grove takes control of it.
spirit-card.arcanes.desc: When you play this card under a Grove, you can secretly place an Arcane token on any Spirit card in the Groves (including opponent's). Revealed during resolution!
spirit-card.ruses.desc: When you play this card under a Grove, you can move one of your Spirit cards to an adjacent Grove. Can be used or passed.
spirit-card.incantations.desc: These symbols are used for recruitment: when you place this card next to your Druid, for each assembled recruitment symbol <recrutement />, you can recruit Elite cards of the corresponding type.
spirit-card.dominations.desc: Victory points. If no player controls all 3 Groves after 4 rounds, the player who has accumulated the most Domination with their cards in play wins the game.
spirit-card.elder-spirit-3.force: 1<force /> per Elder Spirit card you own in the same grove
spirit-card.elder-spirit-red-1.dominatio: 1<domination /> per different elite or base Spirit card you own in the same grove
spirit-card.elder-spirit-red-2.dominatio: 1<domination /> per Elder Spirit card you own in the same grove
elder.effect.show-arcane: <elderShowArcane /> Immediately after placement, look at a face-down arcane token from the reserve, then replace it in the reserve.
elder.effect.take-spirit: <recrutement /> Immediately after placement, recruit an elite Spirit card of your choice and place it on top or under your deck.
elder.effect.place-under-deck: <elderPlaceCard /> Immediately after placement, take the bottom card from your deck and place it in this Elder Spirit's Grove.
spirit-card.base.desc: A base Spirit card. These cards make up your starting deck and can be placed under Groves or next to the Druid to recruit Elites.
spirit-card.bear-elite.desc: A Bear Elite Spirit card. Recruited using your Druid's Bear incantations. Generally focused on brute Strength.
spirit-card.fox-elite.desc: A Fox Elite Spirit card. Recruited using your Druid's Fox incantations. Generally focused on Tricks and Arcanes.
spirit-card.owl-elite.desc: An Owl Elite Spirit card. Recruited using your Druid's Owl incantations. Generally focused on secret Arcanes.
spirit-card.elder.desc: An Elder Spirit card. Available from the common river. It provides Domination and special placement effects.
spirit-card.druid.desc: The Druid is your command card. It doesn't fight directly (Strength 0), but it's essential for recruiting new cards and amplifying your forces.
grove.role: The Groves are the battlefields of the game. Each round, both players can place their Spirit cards there (one card each per Grove). At the end of the round, each player's total Strength under this Grove is compared: the winner takes control.
grove.type.bonus: All your {groveType, select, bear{Bear} fox{Fox} other{Owl}} Spirit cards gain +1<force /> Strength during this Grove's resolution.
grove.force-calc.desc: Each card's Strength + Grove type bonus (+1<force />) + Druid transformation (+1<force /> if same type) + revealed Arcane tokens.
grove.tie.desc: In case of a tie, nobody takes control of the Grove. The marker stays neutral.
grove.victory-cond.desc: Controlling all 3 Groves at the end of a round triggers an immediate victory! Otherwise, after 4 rounds, total Domination (<domination />) decides the winner.
round-card.role: This card indicates the active player. Box 1 faces the first player of the current round. The marker moves along the track and the active player is the player on the same side as the marker. The first player alternates each new round.
round-card.duration.desc: The game lasts a maximum of 4 rounds. Each round consists of 6 turns (2 per Grove).
round-card.end-early.desc: If a player controls all 3 Groves at the end of a round, the game ends immediately — no need to play all 4 rounds!
round-card.scoring.desc: After 4 rounds without a clear winner, the player who has accumulated the most Domination (<domination />) points with their Spirit cards in play wins the game.
arcane-token.role: When you play a Spirit card with Arcane slots
arcane-token.role2: , you can place an arcane token, face down, on any Spirit card in the Groves — yours or your opponent's (except an opponent's Elder Spirit and your Druid). It is revealed during Grove resolution and adds its value to the total Strength of the card owner.
arcane-token.reveal: All Arcane tokens are revealed simultaneously during Grove resolution at the end of the round. The surprise effect can completely reverse the outcome!
arcane-token.discard.title: Discard Token
arcane-token.discard.desc: This token gives no Strength bonus; the card it's placed on is immediately discarded along with all arcane tokens on it.

tuto.welcome: Welcome to Bloody Grove! In this tutorial, you face Sylvara, who plays the green druid. You play the black druid.
tuto.goal:
There are 2 ways to win:
• capture all 3 Groves in a single round for immediate victory;
• or hold the most Domination () points at the end of the 4 rounds.
tuto.hand: Here is your hand (4 Spirit cards) and your Druid. Each round, you choose between 2 actions: Send a spirit to fight in the active grove or use a spirit to transform your Druid.
tuto.show-arcane: Before playing, each player can secretly look at an Arcane token from the reserve. Click on a token to look at it!
tuto.show-arcane-value: This token is worth +4! Remember it carefully — it will be your secret weapon. Now put it back in the reserve.
tuto.ai-show-arcane: Sylvara also secretly looks at an Arcane token from the reserve...
tuto.turn1: It's your turn! Grove 1: the Bear. Play the Bear Spirit under this Grove — Bear cards receive +1 type bonus here!
tuto.turn1-result: Perfect! This spirit has 3, +1 Bear type bonus = 4 total. Sylvara now plays twice in a row before your next turn...
tuto.druid-intro: Grove 2: the Fox. Rather than playing directly there, use the Druid mechanic! Place this spirit to the left of the Druid.
tuto.druid-symbol: By placing this spirit, you formed a Fox recruitment symbol <recrutement /> between the spirit card and your Druid!
tuto.druid-incantation-1: Each completed recruitment symbol lets you take the visible card of the same type. You can put it on top of your deck, under your deck, or in your hand.
tuto.druid-incantation-2: Take the Fox Elite card into your hand.
tuto.druid-transformation: The spirit card is then placed on your Druid: Fox transformation activated! All your Fox cards in the Groves now gain +1. Your turn for the Owl Grove!
tuto.arcane-intro: Grove 3: the Owl. Play this spirit that has an Arcane slot () — you'll be able to place a secret token!
tuto.arcane-place: An Arcane slot is available! Place the Arcane token face down on your Owl — Sylvara won't know its value!
tuto.arcane-hidden: Token placed face down! You know it's worth +4, but Sylvara doesn't. It will be revealed during resolution.
tuto.ruse-explain: Sylvara played a spirit with a trick . A Trick allows moving a Spirit from one Grove to another. Sylvara chooses not to use it this time.
tuto.end-round: The round ends! You must first discard the remaining cards from your hand under your deck, in the order of your choice.
tuto.resolve-grove0: Resolution begins grove by grove. Bear Grove: your bear spirit (Strength 3 + 1 type = 4) beats Sylvara. You win the Grove!
tuto.take-elder-0: Choose an Elder Spirit from the river to strengthen this Grove next round.
tuto.resolve-grove1: Fox Grove: Sylvara wins this Grove. She chooses an Elder Spirit...
tuto.arcane-reveal: Owl Grove: the Arcane token is revealed! Owl spirit (Strength 1) + Owl bonus (+1) + Arcane token (+4) = 6. You win this Grove!
tuto.take-elder-2: Choose an Elder Spirit for this Grove.
tuto.replace-spirit: By taking an Elder Spirit, you must discard a Spirit card (non-Elder) from the same Grove. Click the card to discard.
tuto.conclusion: Congratulations! You've mastered the basics of Bloody Grove. Keep playing to discover the Elder Spirits' effects and master Tricks! Remember the 2 paths to victory: capture all 3 Groves in a single round, or hold the most Domination () points after the 4 rounds.
help.rule.title: Game Turn
help.rule.intro: On your turn, choose between two actions:
help.rule.invoke-1: Choose a Spirit card from your hand and place it, face up, under the <bold>active Grove</bold>.
help.rule.invoke-2: If there are already Spirit cards under this Grove, place it on the last one, slightly offset so the <force /> strength and type of the card are always visible.
help.rule.invoke-3: Then apply any Trick <ruse /> or Arcane <arcane /> effects on the card.
help.rule.transform-1: Choose a Spirit card from your hand and place it, face up, to the left or right of your Druid card.
help.rule.transform-2: For each completed Recruitment <recrutement /> symbol, recruit the visible Elite Spirit card of the corresponding animal.
help.rule.transform-3: For each recruited card, you can choose to: add it to your hand, place it face down under your deck, or face down on top of your deck.
help.rule.transform-4: The played Spirit card is then placed on the Druid and becomes your current <bold>Transformation</bold>: all your cards of this type in the Groves gain +1<force />.
help.rule.conclusion: Then, advance the cube on the Round card. The player whose side the cube is on starts their turn.
